doc.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant Interview, 1962-05-17
doc.interviewee: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant

title: A.C. Synigal's taste in jazz and dance music
summary: Asked his preference, Mr. Synigal says he loves jazz and Dixieland dance music.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: You know, we haven't hardly talked to you at all. The ladies are keeping you quiet over there.
You ought to say something. You ought to say something. What kind of music do you prefer yourself?

Well, really, I love jazz music, Dixon Land music, I like dance music. Of course, that's what I've been following all my days. I always did dance with Bob Bill and Dixon Land music and jazz music. And jazz at that time was hard to go so.
